content:
Google Ads catches people who are already searching. Facebook and Instagram ads work differently: they put your offer in front of people who were not looking for it yet, based on where they live, their interests and how they behave on Meta's apps. That makes them useful for a new cafe on Golf Course Extension Road, a D2C brand launching a product, a coaching institute opening admissions or a real estate project on Dwarka Expressway. It also makes them easy to waste money on, because the platform will happily deliver cheap clicks and cheap leads that never convert.

This page covers how we plan and manage Meta ads (Facebook and Instagram) for Gurugram businesses, and the decisions that matter most.

The Three Decisions That Shape Every Campaign

1. Where the lead goes

You have three main options, and the right one depends on how your sales team works:

  • Instant forms inside Facebook: quick for the user and usually low cost per lead, but quality can be weak because people submit with one tap. We add qualifying questions or a review step to raise quality.
  • Click-to-WhatsApp ads: the ad opens a WhatsApp chat with your business. In Gurugram this often suits clinics, salons, home services, restaurants and coaching, where customers are used to asking questions on WhatsApp first. It needs someone to reply quickly.
  • Website landing page: slower for the user but gives you better control and more data. Suits e-commerce and high-value enquiries.

2. Who sees the ads

We usually target by location (a radius around your premises or selected areas of Gurugram and nearby NCR), age where relevant, and a few broad interests, then let Meta's delivery system find responsive people. Custom audiences built from your website visitors, video viewers, Instagram engagers and customer lists (uploaded securely and hashed) are used for remarketing and lookalikes.

3. What the ad actually says and shows

On Meta, creative does most of the targeting work. A clear short video of your actual clinic, food, classroom or site visit usually does better than a polished stock image. We plan creative in sets so we can test different hooks, formats (Reels, Stories, feed) and offers.

Our Setup Process

  1. Week 1: Accounts and tracking. We check or set up Meta Business Manager (Business Portfolio) under your ownership, connect your Facebook Page, Instagram account and WhatsApp Business number, install the Meta Pixel and, where your website allows, the Conversions API for more reliable tracking.
  2. Week 1-2: Offer and creative plan. We agree on the offer, write ad copy in English, Hindi or Hinglish depending on your audience, and brief you on the photos and videos we need.
  3. Week 2: Launch. A small number of campaigns go live with separate ad sets for testing, and lead notifications are routed to your team by email, sheet or CRM.
  4. Weeks 3-6: Test and cut. We pause weak creative, move budget to what produces qualified leads and refresh ads before the audience gets tired of them.
  5. Monthly: Review. We look at lead quality with your team, not just lead count, and plan the next round of creative.

What You Will Need to Provide

  • Admin access to your Facebook Page and Instagram account, and a Business Portfolio in your company's name
  • Your own payment method on the ad account
  • Raw photos and phone videos of your product, premises, team or project; we can guide you on shooting them
  • A person who responds to leads and WhatsApp messages within minutes during working hours
  • Weekly feedback on which leads were genuine

How Results Are Measured

Meta's own dashboard reports a lot of numbers, and several of them flatter the ads. We focus on the ones that connect to revenue:

  • Cost per qualified lead
  • Lead-to-visit or lead-to-sale rate
  • Messaging conversations started
  • Purchases and return on ad spend (e-commerce)
  • Frequency and creative fatigue
  • GA4 sessions and conversions from paid social

For businesses selling offline, the most useful measure is your own lead sheet marked with outcomes. When possible, we send those outcomes back to Meta through the Conversions API so the platform learns which leads were real.

Where Gurugram Businesses Go Wrong With Meta Ads

  • Boosting posts from the Page: the Boost button offers little control over objective, placement or tracking. It is fine for a quick announcement, not for lead generation.
  • Chasing the lowest cost per lead: a form with no questions will produce cheap leads, many of whom do not remember filling it. Real estate channel partners know this problem well.
  • Using the same creative for months: performance drops as the same people see the same ad repeatedly.
  • Ad account owned by a freelancer: if the relationship ends, you lose the Pixel data, audiences and history.
  • Slow follow-up: a lead called back the next day has often already spoken to two competitors.

When Meta Ads Are Not the Right Channel

Facebook and Instagram ads are a poor fit for urgent-need services where people search at the moment of need, such as emergency plumbing or towing, where Google is stronger. They also struggle for niche B2B offers aimed at a few specific decision-makers, such as industrial suppliers in the Manesar belt, where LinkedIn or direct outreach often works better. And if you cannot produce any photos or videos of your own, results tend to be weak.

Facebook Ads FAQs

Should we run ads on Facebook, Instagram or both?

Usually both, from the same campaign. Meta decides placement based on where your audience responds. For younger audiences in Gurugram, most delivery often ends up on Instagram Reels and Stories, but we let the data decide rather than assume.

Our leads never pick up the phone. What can we do?

Add qualifying questions to the form, use a higher-intent form type, call within minutes, and send a WhatsApp message immediately after submission. We also check if the ad promised something the form does not deliver.

Do you create the videos?

We write scripts, plan shots and edit the footage you record, and we can arrange a shoot at your premises for an added cost. Simple phone videos shot well often outperform expensive productions.

What will it cost?

Ad spend is paid directly to Meta and depends on how many people you want to reach and how competitive your audience is. Our management fee depends on campaign count and creative volume. We share a fixed quote after a free consultation.

Are there restrictions for property or finance ads?

Meta applies special rules to some categories, such as financial products and, in certain countries, housing, and may limit targeting options. We check the current policy for your category before launch so ads are not rejected.
